question:
Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: league that had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season refers to MAX(league_name WHERE season = '2008/2009');

prediction.sql:
SELECT L.XCL_005
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY COUNT(M.XCL_006) DESC
LIMIT 1;
